Rhea has no reaction for it (searches for gadusol, deoxygadusol and mycosporine on 2026-11-21 found RHEA:49560, RHEA:50220 and the vertebrate gadusol reactions RHEA:78171 and RHEA:78167 only). 4-deoxygadusol has no ChEBI entry (search on 2026-11-21; PubChem CID 85926716), so it is not listed as a participant (USER DECISION 6, UNVERIFIED.md, D1). So the reaction has a substrate and no product in the table. Small molecules (phosphate, H2O, H+, S-adenosylmethionine, ATP, ADP) are not listed as participants.

No fungal protein is linked to this reaction. 4-deoxygadusol has no ChEBI entry (search on 2026-11-21; PubChem CID 85926716), so it is not listed as a participant (USER DECISION 6, UNVERIFIED.md, D1). Mycosporine-glycine has no ChEBI entry (PubChem CID 14444485). The reaction has no participant in the table.

Curated: glucosylation of mycosporine-glutaminol to mycosporine-glutaminol-glucoside. The gene is not identified in any fungus (T4). An enzyme activity is reported for Ascochyta fabae spores: a soluble glucosyltransferase that moves glucose from UDP-glucose to mycosporin-2, the amide form being the best acceptor (PMID 24258137, abstract). Whether mycosporin-2 (amide form) is mycosporine-glutaminol is UNVERIFIED. The compound is made by Phaffia rhodozyma and by strain CBS 6938 after integration of the cluster (PMID 36983003), and not by Saccharomyces cerevisiae with the three genes; the gene is not identified (T4). Mycosporine-glutaminol-glucoside has no ChEBI entry (PubChem CID 171990409), so no product is listed.

Curated, hypothesis: formation of mycosporine-glutamicol, the compound with a carboxyl group where mycosporine-glutaminol has the amide. No paper that was read gives the enzyme or the precursor (ligation of another amine to 4-deoxygadusol, or hydrolysis of the amide of mycosporine-glutaminol). T4. No substrate is listed. The glucoside (mycosporine-glutamicol-glucoside, PMID 12717761, 30182254) has no ChEBI entry (PubChem CID 171990350).
